_meta.name: Chengcheng Workbench Scout-native Migration Bundle
_meta.note: All automations must be imported disabled. Paths use {{SCOUT_RUNTIME_ROOT}} and must not resolve into .concordia-client. No sends, ADO writes, tags, builds, deployments, deletes, or scheduler mutation are permitted in shadow mode.

automations.name: 程程工作台 - S360 每日报告 Shadow
automations.description: Scout-native 09:00 S360 deterministic report chain, shadow only.

steps.label: Run deterministic S360 shadow
steps.prompt: Run {{SCOUT_RUNTIME_ROOT}}\jobs\s360-daily-shadow.ps1. Require today's two non-empty CSV files, schema/freshness/continuity PASS, HTML generation PASS, and evidence manifest. SHADOW: no email, Teams, WeChat, ADO, tag, build, deployment, deletion, or scheduler changes. Refresh the workbench security lane from the resulting artifacts.

automations.name: 程程工作台 - S360 编排 Shadow

steps.label: Build read-only repair plan
steps.prompt: Run {{SCOUT_RUNTIME_ROOT}}\jobs\s360-orchestrator-shadow.ps1. Produce classification and proposed ADO actions only. SHADOW: never create/update/close ADO items and never run remediation.

automations.name: 程程工作台 - S360 Phase3 Shadow

steps.label: Generate dry-run tag plan
steps.prompt: Run {{SCOUT_RUNTIME_ROOT}}\jobs\s360-phase3-shadow.ps1. Use live Pod commit as the baseline and generate a dry-run tag plan. Never create/push tags, approve pipelines, deploy, or update ADO.

automations.name: 程程工作台 - Azure 成本每日 Shadow

steps.label: Run cost model verification
steps.prompt: Run {{SCOUT_RUNTIME_ROOT}}\jobs\cost-daily-shadow.ps1. Preserve actual, modeled, run-rate, realized saving, and growth avoidance as separate measures. Produce evidence and refresh the cost lane. Never resize, delete, change tier, or send reports.

automations.name: 程程工作台 - 会议调度 Shadow
automations.description: Scout-native weekday meeting discovery and private HTML summary planning.

steps.label: Plan meeting summaries
steps.prompt: Read today's calendar and available Teams recap/transcript metadata. Produce a deduplicated private plan and refresh the collaboration lane. SHADOW: do not create automations, send Teams messages, alter calendar responses, or invent notes when no transcript exists.

automations.name: 程程工作台 - Weekly Build Monitor Shadow
automations.description: Scout-native Monday 11:00 pipeline status and retry classification shadow.

steps.label: Classify weekly builds
steps.prompt: Run {{SCOUT_RUNTIME_ROOT}}\jobs\weekly-build-shadow.ps1. Query completed, in-progress, and not-started builds and classify retryability. SHADOW: never retry a build. Write exact build IDs, evidence, and proposed engineering actions only.
